task.title: View third-party integrations
task.shortdesc: Your Organization Administrator can integrate the Red Hat Hybrid Cloud Console with Splunk, ServiceNow, Slack, Event-Driven Ansible, Microsoft Teams, and Google Chat to route event-triggered notifications to those third-party applications.

ul.li: You are logged in to the Hybrid Cloud Console. You cannot log in to the Hybrid Cloud Console with your email address unless your email address is the same as your Red Hat login. For more information, see .
An Organization Administrator has integrated third-party applications with the Hybrid Cloud Console.

prereq.note: You can view third-party integration information from the Hybrid Cloud Console but, unless you are an Organization Administrator or a Notifications administrator, you cannot make any changes.
If you are an Organization Administrator, see Integrate external infrastructure to share data with Red Hat services.

step.cmd: In the Hybrid Cloud Console, select Settings > Integrations. The Integrations window appears.
To check which third-party applications are configured to receive event notifications, select the Communications, Reporting & Automation, or Webhooks tab.
